name: Khulna Metropolitan Police — thanas and official numbers
attribution: Khulna Metropolitan Police (police.khulnadiv.gov.bd) and the Khulna DC portal (khulna.gov.bd)
notes: No licence stated. Thana list from the Khulna DC portal ('ভৌগলিক পরিচিতি', 8 metropolitan thanas); numbers from KMP's mobile-number list, a 3-page PDF in the legacy SutonnyMJ font attached to the KMP portal 'যোগাযোগ' page (thana labels transcribed to Unicode in fetch.py). Only institutional numbers are collected: OC and duty-officer police official mobiles (01320-05xxxx), the Commissioner post's official mobile and office phone, the HQ phone/e-mail from 'ডাক যোগাযোগ' and the control-room numbers. Inspectors' mobiles and officers' names are not copied. kmp.police.gov.bd (KMP's own site) answered HTTP 500. No thana is placed in Khulna City Corporation (area_en empty): KMP covers all 31 KCC wards plus 5 unions and no source gives a thana-to-city-corporation list.
